data.name: San Diego Bay - High‑Speed History & Sea Lion Discovery Tour
data.headline: A fast, fun, and photo‑ready adventure on San Diego Bay
data.description: Experience the best of San Diego Bay in one action‑packed ride. This combo tour blends our popular High‑Speed History & Photo Tour with our Sea Lion Discovery experience for a perfect mix of thrills, wildlife, and waterfront storytelling. Cruise past iconic landmarks, capture incredible photos, and get up close to the famous sea lions of Point Loma — all aboard a high‑performance speed boat built for excitement.
data.highlights:
#WHAT YOU WILL SEE:#
- Historic waterfront sites, Navy ships, and San Diego’s working harbor
- The downtown skyline, Coronado Bridge, and scenic photo stops
- Sea lions lounging, barking, and playing on the bait docks
- High‑speed runs across the bay with smooth, exhilarating turns
data.itinerary:
1. Check‑In & Safety Briefing
Arrive 15 minutes early to meet your captain, get fitted with a life jacket, and hear a quick overview of the route and safety guidelines.

2. Depart the Marina
We ease out of the harbor, giving you a moment to settle in, snap a few warm‑up photos, and enjoy the waterfront views.

3. High‑Speed Run Across the Bay
Your captain opens up the throttle for an exhilarating, smooth ride across San Diego Bay — perfect for action shots and big smiles.

4. Waterfront History Highlights
We slow down near iconic landmarks like the USS Midway, Navy ships, the working harbor, and the downtown skyline while your captain shares fun stories and local history.

5. Photo Stop at the Coronado Bridge
A scenic pause for skyline photos, bridge shots, and group pictures with the bay as your backdrop.

6. Sea Lion Discovery
We cruise to the bait docks where San Diego’s famous sea lions lounge, bark, and play. Great for close‑up photos while keeping a safe and respectful distance.

7. Scenic Cruise Back to the Marina
Enjoy a relaxing ride back with more views of the bay, the Navy base, and the waterfront.

8. Return & Wrap‑Up
We arrive back at the dock where you can ask questions, grab final photos, and check out optional add‑ons or souvenirs.

**PLEASE NOTE:** The itinerary listed above is a general outline of the experience. Your captain may adjust the route or sequence at any time based on weather, marine conditions, safety considerations, wildlife activity, or operational needs. These adjustments ensure the safest and most enjoyable experience for all guests.
data.group_size: 6 People at a Time Max. For large group please contact for options

meeting_point.address: 1551 Shelter Island Drive San Diego, CA US 92106
meeting_point.instructions:
##WHERE TO MEET FOR YOUR ACTIVITY##
Please meet your captain before the activity at La Playa Marketplace. This is located near the adult-only pool on the property and is also the watersport rentals office. Your captain will meet you there and walk down to the vessel with you and your party.

*We highly recommend using the restrooms before the excursion, as there are no public restrooms on the bay.*

##PARKING FOR THE ACTIVITY##
Please note that we do not validate parking. Unless you are staying at Kona Kai, San Diego parking is provided on the street and at the park across from the hotel. That being said, remember to arrive early, as parking can be difficult on weekends, holidays, and during the summer.

Sun Protection — Sunscreen, hat with a secure strap, or UV shirt for afternoon departures.
Water Bottle — Stay hydrated before and after the high‑speed portions.
Payment Method — For optional items purchased at the market.
Optional: Wind‑Friendly Hat — Only if it can be secured; loose hats may fly off during high‑speed runs.

data.booking_notes:
We look forward to you joining us!
---
We know you are excited to go on your adventure, but before you do, we want to ensure we go over a few essential things that will help make your adventure so much more fun.

##Things to know before arrival

1) Please ensure a Waiver has been filled out for everyone attending the activity.
2) Please make sure you show up 10 minutes before departure. We depart on time so that everyone can enjoy the most out of the cruise.

*If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us via email at ahoy@keeneradventures.com or by text/call/Whatsapp at +1(619)350-3258.

---

##Gratuity

Our Captains and/or Crew work hard to ensure you and your party have an outstanding time on the water. If you would like to thank them with a little extra, we highly encourage it. The typical gratuity is 20% of the total cost of the ticket, but you can tip however much or little you feel is appropriate. This is, of course, optional and is never required.

data.disclaimers:
⚠️ Activity Disclaimer
By participating in this activity, all guests agree to the following:

Know Your Limits — Guests with back, neck, or mobility concerns should use discretion due to high‑speed sections and dynamic boat movement.

Follow All Keener Adventures Activity Rules — Guests must comply with all policies listed at https://keeneradventures.com/rules/, including following the captain’s commands at all times and respecting wildlife during the tour.

No Glass Items — Glass containers or glass items of any kind are prohibited per our Boat Rental Partner Policies.

Late Arrivals Policy — Guests who arrive late or miss the departure time will not receive credit, refunds, rescheduling, or rain checks.

Responsibility for Minors — Parents and guardians are fully responsible for supervising all minors at all times while on the activity.

Rule Compliance Requirement — Failure to follow crew instructions, safety rules, or wildlife‑respect guidelines may result in immediate cancellation of the activity with no refund or credit issued.
data.faqs:
What is this tour like?
This is a fast, fun, and photo‑ready adventure combining our High‑Speed History & Photo Tour with our Sea Lion Discovery experience. You’ll enjoy high‑speed runs, scenic stops, and an up‑close look at San Diego’s famous sea lions.
Is this tour family‑friendly?
Yes! Kids love the speed and wildlife. We recommend ages 5+ for comfort, but younger children may join at a parent’s discretion.
Will we get wet?
Light spray is possible during high‑speed sections, but most guests stay dry. We recommend sunglasses and a light jacket.
How close do we get to the sea lions?
We get close enough for amazing photos while keeping a safe and respectful distance that protects the animals and their habitat.
Can I bring my phone or camera?
Absolutely — this tour is designed for great photos. Just keep a secure grip during high‑speed sections.
What should I wear?
Comfortable clothing, sunglasses, and a light jacket. Avoid loose hats or items that could blow away during high‑speed runs.
Is the ride bumpy?
The boat is fast and agile, but the ride is generally smooth. Guests with back, neck, or mobility concerns should use discretion.
Where do we meet?
Your confirmation email includes the exact meeting point and check‑in instructions. Please arrive 10 minutes early.
Is Trip Protection available?
Yes — you can add Trip Protection during checkout. It allows you to cancel for any reason 24+ hours before departure and receive 100% future credit.
What if the weather is bad?
We operate in most conditions, but if the captain determines the weather is unsafe, we’ll reschedule or issue a credit.
